concepts.learning_objective: Classify minerals into metallic (ferrous, non-ferrous) and non-metallic (organic, inorganic) groups with examples.
Explain the uneven distribution, inverse quality-quantity relationship and exhaustibility of minerals.

topics.title: Distribution of minerals and mineral belts of India

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the three broad mineral belts of India and the minerals found in each.
Relate the location of India's minerals to the geological structure of the peninsula.

topics.title: Ferrous minerals: iron ore and manganese

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the types and the distribution of iron ore and its important mines in India.
State the uses of manganese and the distribution of its main producing areas.
Describe the occurrence of bauxite and its leading producing areas.
State the uses of copper and locate its main deposits in India.
State the properties and uses of mica and its producing areas.

topics.title: Conventional energy: coal, petroleum and natural gas
topics.ncert_sections: Energy Resources; Coal; Petroleum; Natural Gas

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the geological ages, types and major fields of coal in India.
Explain the occurrence, oilfields and types of refineries of petroleum in India.
Describe the uses and the main reserves of natural gas in India.
Identify uranium and thorium and the areas where they occur in India.
Trace the growth of India's nuclear programme and locate its important power projects.

topics.title: Non-conventional energy sources
topics.ncert_sections: Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Solar; Wind; Tidal and Wave; Geothermal; Bio-energy

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how solar and wind energy are tapped and where India has potential for them.
Describe tidal, geothermal and bio-energy and their examples in India.
Explain why sustainable development calls for conserving mineral and energy resources.
Evaluate measures such as recycling scrap, substitutes and reduced exports for conserving minerals.
